E1_galactic_tide.note: perihelia sit at mid galactic latitudes (mean|sin b| 0.61, p=0.006 vs isotropic) -- but this is a restatement of the cluster sitting at b=-44, not independent tidal evidence.  The discriminators: no concentration toward the galactic equator band the tidal quadrupole would produce, the axis is off both plane and pole, and the signature is m=1 where a tide is m=2.  The galactic tide is disfavoured as the organizing field

E2_omega_decomposition.note: if the varpi cluster were intrinsic and Om purely footprint, mean w would sit near mean(varpi)-mean(Om) = 269 deg; observed is 301 deg -- a ~33 deg discrepancy, so the w clustering carries structure not reducible to footprint-Om plus clustered-varpi (consistent with the b1 finding that R(w) survives the joint empirical null)
